Manifest.Name: Eleanor Story Expand / 上层区的富家千金爱上在下层区开当铺的我：埃莉诺剧情扩展
Manifest.Author: EleanorRomance Team
Manifest.Description: 1.40 adds expression-driven CG window dialogue and scene portrait pairing; fixes optional trade-CG scheduling so it no longer collides with main or daily visits and connects to the correct shop/trade wrap-up; adds the attendant-route salon-buzz visit and smooths post-story visit pacing; and clears stale mid-visit dialogue cursors after text rewrites. Simplified Chinese and English are regenerated, and Japanese and Korean align at 3,157 keys. The 1.39 route rewrite, post-ending dailies, CG and portrait update, and the 1.38 compatibility fixes remain. 1.40 为 CG 窗口对白接入表情与场景立绘；修复可选交易 CG 与主线/日常来访的同日排队冲突，并接回正确的店内/交易收尾；侍从线新增《楼上的风声》并调整结局后来访节奏；读档时清理重写文本的未完成对话游标。简中/英文重新生成，日文/韩文与简中 3,157 键对齐；保留 1.39 四路线文本、结局后日常、CG/立绘更新及 1.38 修复。简体中文 / English / 日语 / 韩语 (ZH / EN / JA / KO)。
